# Danish playable lexicon expanded from hunspell da_DK (Stavekontrolden) (LibreOffice dictionaries da_DK @ 75f5dff8c972fff4a32e4ea8434722c277f02a3f).
# The Danish edition has AE-, OE- and AA-ligature/ring TILES at 4 points each and no Q
# tile, so:
#   * ae-ligature, o-slash and a-ring are PRESERVED, because each has its own tile;
#   * every other marked letter is folded to its base letter;
#   * a word still containing a letter no tile bears -- thorn or eth, which arrive with
#     Faroese and Icelandic names -- is DROPPED, because no tile set can spell it.
# So this file lists playable TILE SEQUENCES: 'cafe' and 'alle' are here, and
# 'Koebenhavn' is spelled with the o-slash rather than 'oe'.
# Not an official tournament list.
